locations.name: Hidden Bunker
locations.description: A secret underground facility now partially destroyed; laser grids have died, walls are cracked from the Darkness's roar, and floodwater surges through the corridors

locations.name: Flooded Bunker Corridor
locations.description: A corridor fully flooded with churning water, lasers dead, ceiling partially collapsed from the Darkness's assault

locations.name: Exit Tunnel
locations.description: A dimly lit tunnel glimpsed through the chaos, offering a path out of the collapsing bunker into unknown territory
notableFeatures: Last escape route from the bunker

locations.name: Hidden Laboratory
locations.description: A secret lab untouched by time, accessible through coral and barnacle-crusted twin doors at the passage's end. Alchemical tanks bubble with strange potions, and a pulsing electric blue tank dominates the room like a heartbeat. An ancient journal on a rusted desk contains knowledge of a three-trial restoration ritual.
notableFeatures: Ancient restoration journal on rusted desk
Tendrils of the Slumbering Darkness seeping through cracks

locations.name: Blox Fruits Grid
locations.description: A vast server filled with unknown dangers and opportunities

items.name: Awakened Fruit
items.description: A mysterious and ancient power with unknown abilities

items.name: Awakened Sea Fruit (Depleted)
items.description: A cobalt-infused awakened fruit from the Sea God's Throne, now fully depleted after expending its final charge to create a seawater shield that held back the Slumbering Darkness's shadow tendrils long enough to escape. Cobalt veins are pale and lifeless.
items.status: Depleted - three trials required for restoration per ancient journal

items.name: Pulsing Electric Blue Potion
items.description: A mysterious potion housed in an alchemical tank that pulses like a heartbeat. Its purpose is unknown but it emanates a faint electric blue luminescence that may be connected to the restoration trials.

items.name: Ancient Restoration Journal
items.description: A journal clamped to a rusted desk containing critical knowledge: 'To restore what the sea gives—three trials must be faced.' Details the path to restoring awakened fruit power.

mainStory.description: Brave Survivor escaped the collapsing Sea God's Throne Chamber by sacrificing the Awakened Sea Fruit's final power to breach the Slumbering Darkness's wall of shadow tendrils. They stumbled into a hidden laboratory untouched by time, where an ancient journal revealed the path forward: three trials must be faced to restore the fruit's power. The Slumbering Darkness is still hunting, its tendrils seeping through the lab's cracks, but it fears something within. The fight is far from over.

restorationSaga.description: The three-trial restoration arc. The Awakened Sea Fruit must be revived through trials yet to be defined. The ancient journal provides the framework; the laboratory may hold the tools.
